Name: Chedorlaomer
Summary: Chedorlaomer was the king of Elam who led the alliance of eastern kings against Sodom and Gomorrah.
KeyStory: After twelve years of rule, Chedorlaomer crushed a rebellion of the plain's cities, took Lot captive, and was himself routed by Abram's night attack.
LifeLesson: Empires rise and fall, but God's promise to Abram outlasted every king of his day.
